reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for automatically sending goal, session, and agent-progress notifications to configured WeCom group webhooks, with settings-based configuration and delivery controls.

summaries.zh: 通过企业微信官方群机器人 webhook 自动推送 DeepSeek Harness 的任务、会话和代理进度通知，并提供设置面板与主动通知工具。
summaries.en: Automatically sends DeepSeek Harness task, session, and agent-progress notifications to configured WeCom group webhooks with a settings panel and callable notification tool.

capabilities: Sends event-driven notifications to configured WeCom group webhooks
Provides an agent-callable wechat_notify notification tool
Stores and updates webhook configuration through a settings panel and local config file
Uses asynchronous network requests with queuing, throttling, deduplication, retries, and timeouts
